title: [Extensibility Request] issue 29901: expose item application entry before find
summary: Adds an event in Undo Sales Shipment Line before the filtered Item Application Entry is retrieved when undoing a drop shipment, so subscribers can adjust loaded fields and avoid JIT load-field errors on extension fields.
key_points: New event fires before the item application entry is found in UnApplyDropShipment
Subscribers can adjust which fields are loaded on the Item Application Entry record
Added in both W1 and RU layers
Lets extensions that add fields to Item Application Entry avoid JIT load-field errors
quote: added an event before finding the item application entry so subscribers can adjust loaded fields
